name: CallbackFilterFields
description: Common filter fields for callback IP queries.

is_stage_1.description: Filter by stage 1 status. true = file downloaded from this IP.

is_stage_2.description: Filter by stage 2 status. true = suspected C2 based on VT/sandbox analysis.

first_seen_after.description: Only include IPs first seen after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

first_seen_before.description: Only include IPs first seen before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_seen_after.description: Only include IPs last seen after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_seen_before.description: Only include IPs last seen before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

has_files.description: If true, only include IPs with associated malware files. If false, only IPs without files.

file_name.description: Filter by file name substring match.

scanner_ips.description: Filter to IPs associated with these scanner IPs.

ips.description: Filter to this specific set of callback IPs.
